Health Functional FoodNiacin 20mgBiotin 900μgVitamin B1 100mgVitamin B12 24μgVitamin B2 40mgVitamin B6 30mgFolate 400μgPantothenic acid 200mgOnce a day

영롱 판토쉴드 비타민BNiacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)케이지앤에프 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Niacin, 900μg of Biotin, 100mg of Vitamin B1, 24μg of Vitamin B12, 40mg of Vitamin B2, 30mg of Vitamin B6, 400μg of Folate, 200mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Niacin, 900μg Biotin, 100mg Vitamin B1, 24μg Vitamin B12, 40mg Vitamin B2, 30mg Vitamin B6, 400μg Folate, 200mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)케이지앤에프

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (20mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (900μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (100mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (24μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (40mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (30mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (200mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 밝은 노란 주황색 분말을 함유한 연한 노란연두색의 장방형 장용성 코팅캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 24개월
Storage 수분 및 열에 의해 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Biotin

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 0.05mg of Biotin, 50mg of Vitamin B1, 0.05mg of Vitamin B12, 40mg of Vitamin B2, 50mg of Vitamin B6, 0.6mg of Folate, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 50mg Niacin, 0.05mg Biotin, 50mg Vitamin B1, 0.05mg Vitamin B12, 40mg Vitamin B2, 50mg Vitamin B6, 0.6mg Folate, 50mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

비타민B콤플렉스Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 25μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 400μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 25μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (25μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연한 연두색의 장방형 제피정제
Shelf life 제조일로부터 2년
Storage 수분 및 열에 의해 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 15mg, 비오틴 30μg, 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 엽산 400μg, 판토텐산 5mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없으며 밝은 노란 주황색의 장방형 제피정제 · (주)대웅제약 1공장 제조

  • 나이아신
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비오틴
    • 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 B1
    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B12
    • 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B2
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 엽산
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
    • 세포와 혈액생성에 필요
    • 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요
  • 판토텐산
    • 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 1회1회 1정물과 함께

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 400μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)대웅제약 1공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없으며 밝은 노란 주황색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 실온에서 보관

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 50μg of Biotin, 50mg of Vitamin B1, 200μg of Vitamin B12, 40mg of Vitamin B2, 50mg of Vitamin B6, 1020μg of Folate, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Niacin labelled (50mg / 700mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (50μg / 700mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (50mg / 700mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (200μg / 700mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (40mg / 700mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (50mg / 700mg), 80~150%

Pantothenic acid labelled (50mg / 700mg), 80~180%
